            long bb= (long)(fbReal[i]+0.5);
            long cc= (long)(faImag[i]+0.5);
            res[i]=(int)((aa + (bb%mod)<<15 + (cc%mod)<<30)%mod);
        }
        return res;
    }

    private void fft(double[] a, double[] b, boolean inverse) {
        int n=a.length; int shift=32-Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(n);
        for (int i=1; i<n; i++) {
            int j= Integer.reverse(i<<shift);
            if (i<j) {
                double tmpa=a[i]; a[i]=a[j]; a[j]=tmpa;
                double tmpb=b[i]; b[i]=b[j]; b[j]=tmpb;
            }
        }
        for (int len=2; len<=n; len<<=1) {
            int half=len>>1;
            double[] cs=new double[half], sn=new double[half];
            for (int i=0; i<half; i++) {
                double angle=2*Math.PI*i/len*(inverse?-1:1);
                cs[i]=Math.cos(angle); sn[i]=Math.sin(angle);
            }
            for (int i=0; i<n; i+=len) {
                for (int j=0; j<half; j++) {
                    double wA=cs[j], wB=sn[j];
                    double uA=a[i+j], uB=b[i+j];
                    double vA=a[i+j+half]*wA - b[i+j+half]*wB;
                    double vB=a[i+j+half]*wB + b[i+j+half]*wA;
                    a[i+j]=uA+vA; b[i+j]=uB+vB;
                    a[i+j+half]=uA - vA; b[i+j+half]=uB - vB;
                }
            }
        }
        if (inverse) {
            for (int i=0; i<n; i++) {
                a[i]/=n; b[i]/=n;
            }
        }
    }
}
